0.th: แย่งคนที่จีบเพื่อนสนิท
0.vi: Cướp người theo đuổi bạn thân?
0.fil: Mananakaw pa ng suitor ng bestie ko?

1.th: ฟังดูไม่มีเส้นตายเลยจริงๆ
1.vi: Nghe thật là không có giới hạn.

2.th: แต่หลังจากตายไปหนึ่งครั้ง
2.vi: Nhưng sau khi chết một lần,
2.fil: Kaso pagkatapos mamatay nang isang beses,

3.en: integrity is the cheapest thing I own.
3.th: เส้นตายเป็นของถูกที่สุดสำหรับฉัน
3.vi: giới hạn với tôi là thứ rẻ nhất.
3.id: prinsip jadi hal paling murah bagiku.
3.ms: batas jadi benda termurah bagi saya.
3.fil: ang prinsip ko na ang pinakamura sa lahat.

4.en: Song Jingyi has no shortage of suitors.
4.th: ซ่งจิ้งอี้ไม่เคยขาดคนจีบ
4.vi: Tống Tĩnh Doanh không thiếu người theo đuổi.
4.id: Song Jingyi tak pernah kekurangan penggemar.
4.ms: Song Jingyi tak pernah kekurangan peminat.
4.fil: Hindi kulang si Song Jingyi sa manliligaw.

5.en: Handsome ones, fit ones, rich ones.
5.th: หล่อๆ ฟิตๆ รวยๆ
5.vi: Đẹp trai, dáng chuẩn, giàu có.

6.en: Even ones who help her with school.
6.th: หรือคนที่ช่วยเรื่องเรียนเธอได้
6.vi: Cả người giúp được cô ấy trong học tập.
6.fil: At mga tutulong sa pag-aaral niya.

7.en: What makes you think you can win her?
7.th: เธอคิดว่าจะสะกดใจเขาได้ง่ายๆ เหรอ?
7.vi: Cậu nghĩ dễ dàng khiến cô ấy đổ à?
7.ms: Awak rasa senang nak menawan dia?
7.fil: Sa tingin mo madali mong mabihag 'yan?

9.en: Even if Jingyi doesn't pick me,
9.th: แม้จิ้งอี้จะไม่เลือกฉัน
9.vi: Dù Tĩnh Doanh không chọn tôi,
9.ms: Kalau pun Jingyi tak pilih saya,
9.fil: Kahit hindi ako ang piliin ni Jingyi,

10.th: ก็ไม่ถึงตาเธอหรอก

11.en: I thought you were just ugly.
11.th: ฉันคิดว่าเธอแค่ขี้เหร่
11.vi: Tôi cứ tưởng cậu chỉ xấu.

12.th: ไม่คิดว่าจะไร้ยางอายขนาดนี้
12.vi: Ai ngờ còn đáng xấu hổ hơn.

13.th: ฉันไร้ยางอาย?

14.en: We're both in the sports department.
14.th: เราเรียนคณะกีฬาเดียวกัน
14.vi: Cả hai học cùng khoa thể dục.

15.en: You knew I'm Jingyi's best friend.
15.th: คุณรู้ว่าฉันเป็นเพื่อนสนิทของจิ้งอี้
15.vi: Anh biết tôi là bạn thân của Tĩnh Doanh.
15.ms: Awak tahu saya kawan baik Jingyi.
15.fil: Alam mong best friend ako ni Jingyi.

16.en: You pretended to care about me,
16.th: เธอแกล้งทำดีกับฉัน
16.vi: anh giả vờ quan tâm tôi,
16.ms: awak pura-pura ambil berat pasal saya,

17.th: ปล่อยสัญญาณชวนชู้

18.en: all to get close to Jingyi through me.
18.th: เพื่อใช้ฉันเข้าใกล้จิ้งอี้
18.vi: để thông qua tôi tiếp cận Tĩnh Doanh.
18.fil: para maka-approach kay Jingyi through me.

19.th: งั้นใครใช้ใครก่อนกันแน่?
19.vi: Vậy ai lợi dụng ai trước?

20.th: มีเค่อดูเซงซ็อก
20.vi: Mi Ke nhìn có vẻ ngơ ngác,

21.en: yet she saw right through me.
21.th: แต่กลับมองทะลุความคิดฉัน
21.vi: mà nhìn thấu tâm địa tôi.
21.ms: tapi dia nampak menembus hati saya.
21.fil: pero nabasa niya ang iniisip ko.

23.th: เจียงมู่อี้

24.th: งั้นเราทำข้อตกลงกันดีไหม
24.vi: Thôi, mình làm một thỏa thuận đi.
